Foto sem data de um avião Boeing E-3 Sentry destruído na Base Aérea Príncipe Sultan, a cerca de 100 km a sudeste da capital da Arábia Saudita, Riad — Foto: CBS News via BBC

A rede de TV americana CBS, parceira da BBC nos Estados Unidos , obteve imagens que mostram extensos danos ocorridos em diversas instalações americanas no Oriente Médio, causadas por ataques do Irã .

As fotos foram fornecidas por militares da ativa. Elas mostram um avião-radar destruído, trailers arrasados e construções gravemente danificadas.

As fotos não têm data. Elas foram tiradas em bases e instalações americanas na Arábia Saudita e no Kuwait.

Um membro das Forças Armadas americanas, não identificado pela CBS, declarou que "estes são danos importantes às nossas bases que não foram comunicados ao público americano".

"Estávamos ali, com os olhos fechados, sendo diretamente atacados."

A Casa Branca foi consultada e orientou a BBC a entrar em contato com o Comando Central dos Estados Unidos, que não respondeu ao nosso pedido de comentários até a publicação desta reportagem.

A BBC não verificou as fotografias de forma independente.

Elas foram publicadas um dia depois que um relatório do órgão fiscalizador do Pentágono confirmou que o Irã danificou e destruiu centenas de construções e estruturas nas bases americanas no Oriente Médio.

Uma das fotos mostra um Boeing E-3 Sentry destruído na Base Aérea Príncipe Sultan na Arábia Saudita. A aeronave foi partida ao meio e sua cauda foi transformada em um emaranhado de metal.

Esta foto não tem data, mas a BBC Verify (o serviço de verificação de dados e imagens da BBC) confirmou anteriormente uma foto similar, aparentemente do mesmo avião-radar, em março deste ano.

Os sistemas aéreos de alerta e controle (Awacs, na sigla em inglês) Boeing E-3 são usados para detectar e rastrear possíveis alvos a longa distância, a fim de fornecer alerta precoce de possíveis ameaças.

Na época, uma autoridade dos Estados Unidos declarou à agência Reuters que 12 militares americanos ficaram feridos, dois deles com gravidade, em um ataque iraniano à base aérea.

Imagens reveladas pela CBS News da base Camp Buehring, no Kuwait, após ataque iraniano — Foto: CBS News via BBC

Duas imagens sem data, supostamente do acampamento Buehring, no Kuwait, mostram trailers amassados e uma grande estrutura em forma de tenda em pedaços, com fumaça subindo no local.

Outra imagem mostra um edifício de quatro andares, atingido por um ataque iraniano ao acampamento Arifjan, no Kuwait.

Foram relatados danos ao local em março. Eles incluíram equipamentos de comunicação via satélite, mas não se sabe ao certo se esta imagem é do mesmo ataque.

Danos a uma construção no acampamento Arifjan, no Kuwait — Foto: CBS News via BBC

Brian Katulis, que já trabalhou no setor de segurança nacional em governos democratas e republicanos, declarou que os danos visíveis nas imagens demonstram que os Estados Unidos "não prepararam adequadamente suas defesas".

"E existem fortes evidências de que adversários americanos, como a China e a Rússia, podem ter ajudado o Irã nos ataques", destaca Katulis. Atualmente, ele é pesquisador sênior do Instituto do Oriente Médio.

"O governo Trump não fez nada para enfrentar estas vulnerabilidades", segundo ele.

As imagens foram publicadas logo após o relatório do órgão fiscalizador do Pentágono que concluiu que ataques iranianos "danificaram e destruíram centenas de construções e estruturas em bases dos Estados Unidos no Kuwait, Bahrein, Catar, Emirados Árabes Unidos, Arábia Saudita, Iraque, Omã e Jordânia durante o conflito".

O organismo também destacou que as perdas com equipamentos totalizaram US$ 3,7 bilhões (cerca de R$ 19 bilhões). Ao todo, os Estados Unidos gastaram com a guerra US$ 33,4 bilhões (cerca de R$ 172 bilhões) até 29 de junho, segundo o relatório.

Nos meses que se seguiram ao início da guerra, "dezenas de aeronaves americanas foram destruídas ou danificadas", prossegue o documento.

O relatório lista diversas aeronaves danificadas. Elas incluem cinco aviões de reabastecimento, que foram "danificados ou destruídos em terra na Arábia Saudita, por munições iranianas".

Outro relatório, do Escritório de Orçamento do Congresso americano (CBO, na sigla em inglês), indica que o avião E-3 não é mais produzido e precisaria ser substituído com um equivalente mais moderno, o E-7.

Segundo o CBO, a aeronave E-3, sozinha, custa US$ 500 milhões (cerca de R$ 2,6 bilhões) e o custo total estimado dos equipamentos perdidos em batalha, incluindo aviões, drones e um sistema de defesa aérea em grande altitude, soma US$ 1,9 bilhão (cerca de R$ 9,8 bilhões).

O CBO afirma que sua análise está sujeita a "incertezas", pois o Departamento da Defesa não respondeu aos seus pedidos de informações, o que levou a agência a confiar em bancos de dados governamentais e relatórios públicos.

Além disso, a extensão dos reparos e da reconstrução planejada pelas Forças Armadas americanas ainda é incerta, segundo o relatório.

Trailers destruídos por um ataque iraniano no acampamento Buehring, no Kuwait — Foto: CBS News via BBC

Brian Katulis afirma que, embora "estes custos demonstrem como o governo Trump queimou preciosos recursos militares, sem ter muito o que mostrar por isso", o maior prejuízo foi para a prontidão militar americana como um todo.

"Os Estados Unidos precisaram desviar equipamentos militares da Ásia para o Oriente Médio, deixando o país e seus parceiros na Ásia mais expostos e vulneráveis à China", declarou ele.

"Além disso, o esgotamento das munições americanas deixa a Rússia mais disposta a sondar as vulnerabilidades junto aos aliados americanos da Otan e a prosseguir com sua guerra de agressão contra a Ucrânia."

Os Estados Unidos detêm os recursos financeiros necessários para repor as perdas materiais. Mas o país já enfrenta problemas orçamentários e pode não ser capaz de fazer esta reposição com a rapidez necessária para se preparar para possíveis recrudescimentos no Oriente Médio ou em outras partes do mundo, segundo Katulis.

A pressão do público e dos políticos sobre a Casa Branca para encontrar um fim para o conflito com o Irã aumentou. A guerra começou em 28 de fevereiro, quando os Estados Unidos e Israel lançaram ataques conjuntos ao país.

Desde o início do conflito, o Irã atacou repetidamente as bases americanas e seus Estados aliados no Golfo, além de Israel.

Foto sem data mostra fumaça subindo de uma estrutura danificada por um ataque iraniano no acampamento Buehring, no Kuwait — Foto: CBS News via BBC

Na noite de terça-feira (15), a Câmara dos Representantes americana votou pela terceira vez a favor do fim da guerra no Irã, ao aprovar uma medida que obrigaria o presidente Donald Trump a encerrar as ações militares, realizadas sem aprovação do Congresso.

A medida foi aprovada com o apoio de vários republicanos e pode ser a última votação da Câmara sobre o assunto, antes das eleições americanas de meio de mandato, a serem realizadas em novembro.

Seu caminho é incerto, já que o Senado americano não indicou se irá levar o assunto adiante.

No mesmo dia, o congressista republicano Thomas Massie, em fim de mandato, anunciou uma tentativa de impeachment do secretário da Defesa americano, Pete Hegseth, com o surgimento de novos detalhes sobre o preço da guerra no Irã para os Estados Unidos.

O governo Trump saiu em defesa de Hegseth, com o procurador-geral americano Todd Blanche declarando aos repórteres que ele vem "fazendo um trabalho fenomenal".

articles.title: Concurso da Sema-MT abre inscrições com salários de até R$ 10,4 mil | G1
articles.standfirst: Inscrições seguem até 14 de outubro e provas estão previstas para dezembro. Seleção é para cadastro de reserva em 24 perfis profissionais de nível superior.
articles.summary: Inscrições seguem até 14 de outubro e provas estão previstas para dezembro. Seleção é para cadastro de reserva em 24 perfis profissionais de nível superior.
articles.body:
Concurso da Sema-MT abre inscrições com salários de até R$ 10,4 mil — Foto: Divulgação

As inscrições para o concurso público da Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso (Sema-MT) estão abertas, a partir desta quinta-feira (17), para profissionais de nível superior. Os salários iniciais chegam a R$ 10.491,97 , com jornada de 40 horas semanais.

O concurso é destinado à formação de cadastro de reserva, ou seja, o edital não estabelece um número imediato de vagas. As nomeações poderão ocorrer conforme a necessidade do serviço, conveniência e oportunidade da administração pública durante a validade da seleção.

Ao todo, são 24 perfis profissionais, distribuídos entre os cargos de Analista de Meio Ambiente e Analista de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social.

Para Analista de Meio Ambiente, a remuneração inicial é de R$ 10.491,97. Já para Analista de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social, o salário inicial é de R$ 8.269,16. Nos dois casos, a jornada é de 40 horas por semana. O edital estabelece que os candidatos aprovados e nomeados serão enquadrados no nível e na classe iniciais das respectivas carreiras.

Órgão: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso (Sema-MT)

Cargos: Analista de Meio Ambiente e Analista de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social

Salários iniciais: de R$ 8.269,16 a R$ 10.491,97

O concurso terá caráter eliminatório e classificatório e será composto por prova objetiva e prova discursiva. Segundo o edital, as duas avaliações serão aplicadas pela Fundação Cesgranrio.

As provas estão previstas para 13 de dezembro de 2026. O edital prevê a aplicação em Cuiabá e informa que, caso não haja locais suficientes ou adequados na capital, as avaliações poderão ser realizadas também em Várzea Grande.

Para os candidatos que concorrerem como pessoas com deficiência, a avaliação por equipe multiprofissional será realizada exclusivamente em Cuiabá.

As inscrições seguem abertas até 14 de outubro de 2026 e devem ser feitas pela internet , conforme as regras estabelecidas no edital. A taxa é de R$ 150.

Como a seleção é destinada exclusivamente à formação de cadastro de reserva, a aprovação não significa nomeação imediata. Os candidatos serão chamados conforme a classificação e as nomeações realizadas durante o período de validade do concurso. O edital também prevê reserva de vagas para pessoas com deficiência e para candidatos negros, aplicada às nomeações que ocorrerem durante a validade da seleção.

articles.title: Cadu de Lula recebe propostas do MPRN e promete transparência no RN | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato recebeu propostas durante evento do Ministério Público para áreas como saúde, educação, segurança pública e meio ambiente.
articles.summary: Cadu de Lula recebeu diretrizes do MPRN para áreas como saúde e educação, comprometendo-se com a transparência e o zelo pelos recursos públicos no estado.
articles.body:
O candidato ao governo do Rio Grande do Norte pelo PT, Cadu de Lula, participou, na tarde desta quinta-feira (17), de uma agenda propositiva promovida pelo Ministério Público do Rio Grande do Norte (MPRN). Durante o encontro, representantes dos Centros de Apoio Operacional às Promotorias de Justiça apresentaram propostas para áreas como educação, saúde, meio ambiente e cidadania.

O documento, assinado pelo procurador-geral de Justiça, reúne diretrizes estratégicas para contribuir com soluções estruturais para os principais desafios do estado.

Entre as medidas prioritárias estão o fortalecimento da segurança pública, melhorias na regulação e na oferta de leitos de saúde e o desenvolvimento de uma educação inclusiva. Durante a agenda, Cadu defendeu uma gestão transparente e afirmou que pretende avançar nas políticas de governança e no uso dos recursos públicos.

“Avançar na transparência do governo, o governo hoje é selo ouro em transparência. A gente avançar também em todas as áreas de governança, para que a gente tenha um governo cada vez mais transparente, comprometido com a honestidade, com o zelo dos recursos públicos e também no avanço das políticas públicas. O Ministério Público é uma instância importante de promoção de direitos, como a educação, a saúde, a segurança, e a gente vem aqui ouvir as proposições e se comprometer com as pautas que o Ministério Público julga importantes para o futuro do nosso Estado”.

articles.summary: Candidato à reeleição ao governo da Bahia pelo PT participou de entrevista em rádio e de reunião com profissionais do setor de turismo em Salvador, nesta quinta-feira (17).

Jerônimo Rodrigues destaca propostas para turismo na Bahia — Foto: Reprodução/TV Bahia

O candidato à reeleição ao governo da Bahia, Jerônimo Rodrigues ( PT ), destacou, nesta quinta-feira (17), propostas para o setor do turismo durante agenda em Salvador .

No encontro, Jerônimo afirmou que pretende ampliar o orçamento destinado às áreas e citou parcerias com o governo federal e prefeituras para fortalecer a estrutura turística nos municípios.

O candidato também destacou o potencial do turismo de negócios em diferentes regiões do estado, como o oeste e o extremo sul.

"No meu programa de governo consta a dedicação de mais orçamento para isso. A parceria com o governo federal, com os prefeitos municipais, para fortalecer lá na ponta o atendimento e turismo se faz com infraestrutura. Estradas, rodagens, segurança pública, serviços de saúde, porque beleza nós já temos. Como não é só beleza, podemos falar sobre turismo de negócios. Tem regiões que é muito forte isso, como é o caso do oeste da Bahia, extremo sul, Juazeiro ", afirmou.

Pela manhã, Jerônimo foi entrevistado em uma emissora de rádio, em Salvador À noite, o candidato participa de um comício em Seabra , na região da Chapada Diamantina.

articles.title: Mais de 4,5 mil crianças são vacinadas contra pneumonia e meningite  | G1
articles.standfirst: Nova vacina protege contra 20 sorotipos e substitui a Pneumo 10 gradualmente. Dados são do Ministério da Saúde e foram divulgados nessa terça-feira (15).
articles.summary: Nova vacina protege contra 20 sorotipos e substitui a Pneumo 10 gradualmente. Dados são do Ministério da Saúde e foram divulgados nessa terça-feira (15).
articles.body:
Mais de 4,5 mil crianças menores de 5 anos já foram vacinadas com a Pneumo 20 pelo Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) no Acre. O número foi divulgado pelo Ministério da Saúde nessa terça-feira (15) e considera as doses aplicadas desde o início da estratégia nacional de vacinação , em junho deste ano.

A vacina protege contra 20 sorotipos da bactéria Streptococcus pneumoniae , que pode causar doenças como pneumonia, meningite e otite média . Em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de crianças receberam o imunizante.

⏩A Pneumo 20 passou a integrar o Calendário Nacional de Vacinação neste ano e substitui gradualmente a Pneumo 10, que era usada na vacinação infantil da rede pública.

O Acre recebeu 3,6 mil doses da vacina em junho . A aplicação da nova vacina começou no dia 22 do mesmo mês , e o imunizante já está disponível nas unidades de saúde de todos os municípios do estado.

Mais de 4,5 mil crianças são vacinadas contra doenças pneumocócicas no Acre — Foto: rawpixel.com no Freepik

A mudança também ampliou a quantidade de sorotipos cobertos pela vacina. Enquanto a Pneumo 10 protegia contra 10 tipos da bactéria, a nova versão oferece proteção contra 20.

Entre os sorotipos incluídos na Pneumo 20 estão o 3, 6A e 19A, associados à doença pneumocócica invasiva no Brasil. O imunizante também protege contra otite média, que pode provocar complicações, incluindo perda auditiva.

Além disso, a ampliação da proteção ocorre em um cenário de registro de casos graves da doença no país.

Ainda segundo o Ministério da Saúde, entre 2023 e 2025, o Brasil teve 4,6 mil casos de meningite pneumocócica e 1,4 mil mortes . A taxa de letalidade foi de 30%.

Entre crianças menores de 5 anos, foram registrados 589 casos e 187 mortes no mesmo período. A vacinação é a principal forma de prevenir as formas graves das doenças causadas pelo pneumococo.

A proteção é especialmente importante na primeira infância, quando as crianças estão entre os grupos mais vulneráveis às complicações.

A troca da Pneumo 10 pela Pneumo 20 ocorre de forma gradual. Enquanto houver doses da vacina anterior nos estoques, o esquema infantil poderá combinar os dois imunizantes.

Para crianças que estão começando a vacinação, o esquema prevê a Pneumo 20 aos 2 meses , a Pneumo 10 aos 4 meses e uma dose de reforço da Pneumo 20 aos 12 meses . O intervalo mínimo entre a segunda dose e o reforço é de 60 dias.

Quem já completou o esquema com a Pneumo 10 não precisa receber uma dose adicional da Pneumo 20.

Crianças que começaram a vacinação com a Pneumo 13 ou Pneumo 15 na rede privada também podem completar o esquema com a Pneumo 20 pelo SUS, respeitando os intervalos recomendados.

Depois que os estoques da Pneumo 10 terminarem, todas as doses do esquema infantil passarão a ser aplicadas com a Pneumo 20.

Mais de 4,5 mil crianças são vacinadas contra doenças pneumocócicas no Acre — Foto: Divulgação

Além das crianças menores de 5 anos, a vacina também está prevista no SUS para crianças a partir de 2 anos com condições clínicas especiais, idosos a partir de 60 anos ou institucionalizados e povos indígenas a partir de 5 anos sem histórico vacinal. Para os idosos, o esquema é de dose única.

O Ministério da Saúde orienta ainda que pais e responsáveis devem manter a caderneta de vacinação atualizada e procurar uma unidade de saúde para verificar se há doses pendentes.

O histórico de vacinação também pode ser acompanhado pela Caderneta Digital de Saúde da Criança, disponível no aplicativo Meu SUS Digital.

articles.title: Justiça bloqueia bens de ex-prefeito na BA por prejuízo à previdência | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão atende a pedido do Ministério Público da Bahia (MP-BA) e prevê restrição de veículos, imóveis e participações societárias do ex-prefeito de Correntina, Nilson José Rodrigues.
articles.summary: Decisão atende a pedido do Ministério Público da Bahia e prevê restrição de veículos, imóveis e participações societárias do ex-prefeito de Correntina, Nilson José Rodrigues.
articles.body:
Justiça bloqueia bens de ex-prefeito na Bahia por suposto prejuízo à previdência municipal — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

A Justiça determinou o bloqueio de bens do ex-prefeito de Correntina , no oeste da Bahia, Nilson José Rodrigues, conhecido como Maguila, até o limite de R$ 12,7 milhões. A decisão, tomada na terça-feira (10), atende a um pedido do Ministério Público do Estado da Bahia (MP-BA), que apontou um suposto prejuízo aos cofres públicos causado pela falta de repasses de contribuições previdenciárias durante a gestão do ex-prefeito.

A medida foi determinada em uma ação civil pública movida pela promotora de Justiça Suelim Braga. O g1 tenta localizar a defesa de Nilson José Rodrigues.

Segundo o MP-BA, o ex-gestor teria deixado de repassar ao Instituto Municipal de Previdência Social (Imupre) contribuições destinadas ao regime próprio de previdência dos servidores municipais. Ele foi prefeito de Correntina por quatro mandatos: 2005 a 2008; 2009 a 2012; 2017 a 2020 e 2021 a 2024.

Ainda conforme as investigações, o município teria firmado sucessivos parcelamentos e refinanciamentos da dívida previdenciária, o que, conforme o MP-BA, teria comprometido o equilíbrio financeiro do sistema.

A Justiça fixou em R$ 12.726.741,16 o limite da indisponibilidade de bens, correspondente à estimativa do dano apresentada no processo.

A decisão prevê o bloqueio de veículos, imóveis, ações e quotas societárias que estejam em nome do ex-prefeito. Valores mantidos em contas bancárias só poderão ser bloqueados caso os demais bens encontrados não sejam suficientes para atingir o montante determinado.

A indisponibilidade tem caráter cautelar e foi determinada para garantir um eventual ressarcimento aos cofres públicos caso as irregularidades apontadas pelo Ministério Público sejam confirmadas ao final do processo.

articles.title: Douglas Ruas defende expansão das linhas de metrô | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato participou de carreata nesta quinta-feira (17) em Jacarepaguá, na Zona Sudoeste do Rio.
articles.summary: Candidato participou de carreata nesta quinta-feira (17) em Jacarepaguá, na Zona Sudoeste do Rio.
articles.body:
Douglas Ruas (de verde) participa de carreata na Zona Oeste do Rio — Foto: Henrique Coelho/g1

O candidato Douglas Ruas (PL) defendeu uma parceria com a UFRJ para criar um projeto detalhado para criação da Linha 3 do Metrô e expansão das linhas 2 e 4.

O ex-secretário de Cidades participou de uma carreata nesta quinta-feira (17) em Jacarepaguá, na Zona Sudoeste do Rio.

Para Ruas, a relação “promíscua” de governadores anteriores impediu o avanço do metrô em diversas regiões do Estado.

“O que eu estou defendendo é que a partir do início do ano que vem eu vou fazer uma parceria com a UFRJ para que nós possamos ter um planejamento a médio e longo prazo para a extensão das linhas de metrô do Estado do Rio de Janeiro.”

O candidato também falou sobre o desenvolvimento de polos econômicos regionais, citando o caso de Jacarepaguá, na Zona Sudoeste, onde fez uma carreata nesta quinta.

“Nós temos a proposta dos Escritórios de Desenvolvimento Regional que vai desburocratizar todo o acesso dos investidores aqui no Estado do Rio de Janeiro para que eles possam abrir novos negócios e ampliar as atividades já existentes”

articles.title: Motociclista morre em Jundiaí após colisão na Rodovia SP-300 | G1
articles.standfirst: Acidente aconteceu no km 62 da SP-300, no sentido leste, na tarde desta quinta-feira (17). Outra vítima teve ferimentos leves e trecho registrou 5 km de congestionamento.
articles.summary: Motociclista morre em Jundiaí após colisão na Rodovia SP-300 nesta quinta-feira (17); acidente causou 5 km de congestionamento no sentido leste.
articles.body:
Motociclista morre após colisão entre duas motos em rodovia de Jundiaí — Foto: Reprodução/Artesp

Um motociclista morreu após uma colisão entre duas motos na Rodovia Dom Gabriel Paulino Bueno Couto (SP-300), em Jundiaí (SP), na tarde desta quinta-feira (17). Outra vítima teve ferimentos leves e o trecho registrou cerca de 5 quilômetros de congestionamento.

Segundo a Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos Delegados de Transporte do Estado de São Paulo (Artesp), as duas motos seguiam no sentido leste da rodovia quando, no km 62, uma das vítimas, que trafegava pela faixa 2, foi atingida lateralmente por outro motociclista que mudava de faixa.

Com o impacto, o motociclista atingido parou no acostamento, sofreu ferimentos leves e foi atendido por equipes de emergência. O outro permaneceu sobre a faixa 2 da rodovia e morreu no local.

Ainda segundo a Artesp, o acidente provocou interdição parcial da rodovia, e o trânsito ficou concentrado na faixa 2. Houve cerca de 5 quilômetros de congestionamento no trecho.

articles.title: Secretária Nacional de Justiça vê com 'perplexidade' menção de Trump a  Brasil e diz que relatório sobre facções não tem consistência jurídica | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo ela, Brasil não está entre os 23 países classificados pelos EUA como principais produtores ou rotas de trânsito de drogas e não precisaria responder ao documento.
articles.summary: Segundo ela, Brasil não está entre os 23 países classificados pelos EUA como principais produtores ou rotas de trânsito de drogas e não precisaria responder ao documento.
articles.body:
Secretária Nacional de Justiça, Maria Rosa Loula, no 20º Encontro Brasileiro de Segurança Pública — Foto: Cíntia Acayaba/g1

A secretária Nacional de Justiça, Maria Rosa Guimarães Loula, afirmou nesta quinta-feira (17), que causa “perplexidade” a menção ao Brasil em um documento do governo de Donald Trump que critica a atuação brasileira no combate ao Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) e ao Comando Vermelho (CV).

Segundo Maria Rosa, o Brasil não está entre os 23 países classificados pelos Estados Unidos como os principais produtores ou locais de trânsito de drogas. Por isso, na avaliação dela, a referência ao país não tem consistência jurídica e não exigiria uma resposta formal do governo brasileiro.

“Veja, esse documento, que é um documento de determinação, é um documento interno dos Estados Unidos. E esse documento, na verdade, ele identifica estados mais permeáveis e menos atuantes dos 23 estados relacionados. O Brasil não consta. Então, o que causa perplexidade nesse documento é que não havia razão para citar o Brasil”, afirmou Maria Rosa ao no 20º Encontro do Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública, em São Paulo.

“Ou seja, objetivamente o Brasil não está enquadrado naquelas categorias. Ele é um retrato anual, portanto, eu teria que levar em consideração as relevantes medidas que o Estado brasileiro tomou desde o início do ano, por exemplo, a Lei Antifacção. Parece uma menção lateral ao Brasil sem um aprofundamento maior. Então objetivamente, em termos de consistência jurídica não há nenhuma, nem sequer dentro da determinação Brasil está é quase como uma manifestação. Opinativa lateral, que não precisava estar ali”, disse.

No relatório, Trump pede que o governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva adote “com urgência, medidas enérgicas para enfrentar” os grupos. PCC e CV foram incluídos recentemente pelos Estados Unidos na lista de organizações terroristas.

O documento diz ainda que, enquanto outros governos do Hemisfério Ocidental estão tomando “medidas corajosas” para erradicar cartéis, o Brasil não está enfrentando as duas facções.

Segundo o relatório, as organizações criminosas brasileiras “transformaram o país em um centro para o fluxo global de cocaína”.

“Essas organizações terroristas brasileiras representam uma ameaça crescente à paz e à segurança em todo o mundo, e o governo brasileiro precisa urgentemente adotar medidas firmes para enfrentá-las e derrotá-las antes que se espalhem e cresçam”, diz o documento.

Trump afirma ainda que as duas facções constituem uma “ameaça à segurança mundial”.

Maria Rosa afirmou ainda que o governo brasileiro tem atuado consistentemente contra as facções..

“Milhares de operações, milhares de apreensões. Milhares de investigações em andamento. Milhares de processos de cooperação policial, inteligência internacional.”

Para a secretária, porém, não haveria necessidade de uma manifestação oficial brasileira porque o documento americano não coloca o Brasil em nenhuma categoria jurídica.

“Objetivamente não há um motivo para citar o Brasil é o que me parece, Então e e o Brasil não responderia pra qual seria a necessidade do Estado brasileiro se manifestar sobre um documento que coloca o Brasil em nenhum. a categoria jurídica e que é um documento interno dos Estados Unidos.”

Segundo Maria Rosa, uma resposta poderia inclusive dar ao documento uma relevância que, na avaliação dela, ele não possui.

“Poderia inclusive parecer uma mera, como é que eu vou dizer, resposta a uma provocação indevida. Para que se manifestar numa situação que não tem relevância jurídica.”

Brasil não está entre os 23 países citados

O documento assinado por Trump listou 23 países classificados pelos Estados Unidos como locais de trânsito ou produção de drogas. O Brasil não está na relação.

O relatório afirma que, no último ano, Afeganistão, Bolívia, Mianmar e Colômbia também falharam em cumprir as obrigações previstas em acordos internacionais de combate ao narcotráfico.

Ao mesmo tempo, os Estados Unidos pediram que México e Canadá se esforcem mais para impedir a entrada de drogas no país.

Em relação ao Canadá, os EUA querem que o governo local adote medidas para acabar com laboratórios clandestinos de drogas. Sobre o México, a Casa Branca pede medidas contra organizações narcoterroristas que dominam territórios no país.

Trump também fez críticas à China. No documento, ele afirma que, apesar de ter conversado com o presidente Xi Jinping sobre o combate à entrada de fentanil ilegal nos EUA, o país precisa reduzir o fluxo de substâncias usadas na produção da droga.

O presidente norte-americano também aproveitou o relatório para citar mudanças políticas em países da América do Sul.

Segundo o documento, mudanças recentes de governo em alguns países “criaram oportunidades históricas para a cooperação dos Estados Unidos”.

Entre os exemplos citados de forma positiva estão Venezuela, Bolívia e Colômbia. Segundo o relatório, houve avanços nesses países, mas novas medidas ainda são necessárias.

Diplomatas brasileiros disseram à GloboNews que o documento reforça o viés da política externa de Trump na América Latina.

A avaliação também é de que há seletividade por parte da Casa Branca. O mesmo documento faz acenos a novos governos eleitos na América do Sul que também foram apontados por falhas no combate às drogas, mas estão alinhados a Trump.

O relatório é entregue anualmente pelo governo dos EUA ao Congresso e apresenta um panorama da situação do tráfico de drogas no mundo.

articles.standfirst: Incidente aconteceu na tarde desta quinta-feira (17) na Avenida Fábio Barreto, em frente ao Corpo de Bombeiros.
articles.summary: A Avenida Fábio Barreto teve o trânsito totalmente bloqueado no sentido centro-bairro nesta quinta-feira (17) após blocos de concreto caírem de um caminhão.
articles.body:
A Avenida Fábio Barreto foi totalmente interditada no sentido centro-bairro na tarde desta quinta-feira (17) em Ribeirão Preto (SP) por causa de um tombamento de carga.

Segundo a RP Mobi, empresa que gerencia o trânsito na cidade, blocos de concreto que eram transportados por um caminhão caíram no asfalto.

O incidente aconteceu por volta das 16h50 e causou o bloqueio total do trânsito em frente ao Corpo de Bombeiros.

A RP Mobi informou que agentes sinalizaram o trecho e estão no local orientando condutores.

articles.title: Combate ao PCC e CV: ministro rebate críticas de Trump ao Brasil | G1
articles.standfirst: Wellington César Lima e Silva afirmou que dados das operações contra o crime organizado demonstram aumento da atuação repressiva no Brasil. Segundo ele, país não foi incluído formalmente em lista de 23 nações enviada ao Congresso americano.
articles.summary: Wellington César Lima e Silva afirma que dados provam aumento da repressão ao crime organizado e que o Brasil não integra lista oficial dos EUA.
articles.body:
O ministro da Justiça, Wellington Cesar Lima e Silva — Foto: Fernando Calixto/GloboNews

O ministro da Justiça, Wellington César Lima e Silva, rebateu nesta quinta-feira (17), no Rio de Janeiro, as críticas do governo de Donald Trump à atuação do Brasil no combate a facções .

O presidente dos Estados Unidos acusou o Brasil de ter falhado no combate ao Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) e ao Comando Vermelho (CV) – incluídos recentemente pelos EUA na lista de organizações terroristas . As afirmações estão em um documento divulgado pelo Departamento de Estado nesta quarta-feira (16).

Segundo o ministro, os dados sobre as operações realizadas no país demonstram que a avaliação apresentada pelo governo americano “não se confirma” e é “inconsistente” .

“O Estado americano verificará que essa hipótese não se confirma, não é consistente. Os números que apresentamos são superiores ao que existia antes”, declarou o ministro, em entrevista no Escritório Nacional Antifacção, no Centro do Rio.

Wellington afirmou que houve um aumento das ações de repressão ao crime organizado e destacou a integração entre forças federais, estaduais e municipais. Para ele, o Brasil vive atualmente o “momento mais maduro” da resposta estatal às facções criminosas.

“Ficará nítido o esforço do Estado brasileiro nessa defesa e no combate ao crime organizado”, disse.

O ministro citou como avanços a aprovação da chamada Lei Antifacção e a ampliação da capacidade operacional das forças de segurança. Segundo ele, o novo marco regulatório permite uma atuação mais contundente do que a existente anteriormente.

Wellington também ressaltou que o Brasil não foi incluído formalmente em uma lista de 23 países encaminhada pelo governo Trump ao Congresso dos Estados Unidos.

De acordo com o ministro, a menção ao país ocorreu apenas de maneira secundária, sem o enquadramento jurídico atribuído às nações que integram a relação.

“Se não figuramos na lista dos 23 países consolidada nessa iniciativa enviada ao Congresso, a referência ao Brasil foi um comentário lateral. A inclusão na lista, que tem categoria jurídica, não aconteceu”, afirmou.

Operação contra venda irregular de celulares

As declarações foram dadas durante uma coletiva sobre uma operação nacional contra irregularidades na comercialização de celulares.

A ação, realizada no âmbito do programa Celular Seguro, alcançou cerca de 200 estabelecimentos em 15 estados nesta quinta-feira. Segundo o Ministério da Justiça, o objetivo é atingir a cadeia criminosa formada pelo roubo, furto, receptação e revenda de aparelhos. A operação prossegue nesta sexta-feira (18).

Wellington também citou outras ações recentes contra o crime organizado, incluindo uma operação com cerca de 100 mandados de busca e de prisão, além do bloqueio de milhões de reais.

Segundo o ministro, o enfrentamento às organizações criminosas depende da atuação conjunta da Polícia Federal, da Polícia Rodoviária Federal, da Polícia Penal Federal, das forças estaduais, das guardas municipais, da Receita Federal, do Ministério Público e do Poder Judiciário.

articles.title: ​A New Jersey family bought Atlantic City's historic Steel Pier for $4.25 million in 2011; 15 years later, the 5.2-acre amusement landmark is asking $85 million, with possibilities to redevelop it
articles.summary: News News: Atlantic City’s iconic Steel Pier is up for sale, offering a rare chance to buy an operating amusement park built over the Atlantic Ocean, along with .
articles.body: Atlantic City’s iconic Steel Pier is up for sale, offering a rare chance to buy an operating amusement park built over the Atlantic Ocean, along with the rights to extend the property much farther into the sea. The asking price is $85 million, according to a report by the New York Post.The nearly 1,000-foot-long pier sits directly across the boardwalk from the Hard Rock Hotel & Casino and covers roughly 5.2 acres. Ryan Serhant, Michele Zyska and Kevin Bergin of Serhant have listed the property.A piece of New Jersey history, the pier has survived a Depression, two world wars, organised crime, urban decay and a 1969 fire that burned away nearly a third of its original footprint. It remains a classic Jersey Shore amusement park, with a towering Ferris wheel, rides, games and food, along with a built-in helipad. Now it awaits a new buyer.A long historySteel Pier has been part of Atlantic City’s identity for more than a century. It was constructed in 1897 and started operation a year later as a theatre. Once known as the ‘Showplace of the Nation’, it stretched nearly 2,300 feet at its height. It hosted performances from Frank Sinatra to the radio stars of the 1940s. A young Tony Grant launched his ‘Stars of Tomorrow’ talent showcase there, later creating the groundwork for what would become American Bandstand. The pier also appeared in films such as ‘The Long Kiss Goodnight’ and ‘The Bounty Hunter’ and the TV show ‘Cake Boss’. For a brief period in the 1930s, Steel Pier was also the official venue of the Miss America contest.The current structure was rebuilt using steel-reinforced concrete in the late 1980s. It is anchored roughly 90 feet into bedrock and, according to the listing materials, remained intact during Superstorm Sandy in 2012.Now, the pier remains an amusement park, attracting thousands of visitors with its rides, games and the Ferris wheel overlooking the Atlantic.The Catanoso family bought it for $4.25 millionThe Steel Pier was run by longtime South Jersey amusement operators for nearly two decades before the Catanoso family, including brothers Anthony, Charles and William Catanoso, purchased it. When the Catanoso brothers took over Atlantic City's Steel Pier fourteen years ago, they inherited more than carnival rides and a 965-foot boardwalk landmark. They inherited history. In 2011, they bought the property for $4.25 million. Now, the asking price is $85 million, twenty times what they paid for!The jump from $4.25 million to $85 million isn’t simply because of inflation or market cycles. It reflects how the property is valued now. What the Catanoso family operated as a working amusement park, a summer attraction with the Ferris wheel, games, food and the helipad on the roof, it repositioned as something far more valuable. Steel Pier is currently about 150 feet wide and 965 feet long. A perpetual riparian grant allows the property to extend as far as 2,850 feet into the Atlantic Ocean. The existing pier footprint could also potentially be expanded by 25%, according to listing materials. According to Serhant, this is the opportunity to own a piece of ocean. “How often does someone get to own a piece of the ocean? That’s exactly what this offers,” Serhant said in a statement.“The Steel Pier isn’t just 5 acres on the most famous boardwalk in the world, it actually offers the chance to own the Atlantic itself and build something unforgettable on top of it,” he added.In 2008, Steel Pier was approved and permitted for a condo-hotel entertainment complex. So the possibilities are huge. According to Serhant, it is a “developable American history that extends straight into the Atlantic Ocean.”This sale will also bring an end to the Catanoso family’s association with the historic landmark. “The next generation is pursuing other passions. So rather than keep it in the family, they’d rather see it go to an owner who can really realise its full potential,” Zyska told The Post.The property was valued at $87 million last year, after substantial improvements. But according to Serhant, the current asking price is indeed a steal. “If this were in Palm Beach, it would be $400 million, and someone would have bought it already. The fact that it’s even available and there’s an opportunity to purchase it, I just think is super, super special,” Serhant said.What’s next for Steel Pier?The new owner would not necessarily have to keep it as an amusement park. It can be anything. A luxury hotel-residence with retail and entertainment, a music venue or experiential complex, or a residential tower with a commercial base is also possible with 2,850 feet of ocean development rights that no competitor on the boardwalk can match. The 40,000 sq. ft. front building and sky bridge carry an easement into the neighbouring Hard Rock’s convention floor, but the existing pier footprint could potentially be expanded by 25%.Serhant has already conducted what he calls ‘soft conversations with a handful’ of potential buyers. “Executing on a condo-hotel plan would probably be my first plan. You have the rare ability to build out over the ocean itself,” he told the outlet.“If you’re a high-end, high-net-worth hospitality builder, I think Atlantic City is incredible value,” Serhant added.Zyska sees the possibility of music and entertainment uses given the prime location. “If it lands in the right hands, it can really transform the boardwalk, and even that stretch of the Atlantic. It’s really a premier opportunity,” she said.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? Build Your Legacy with TOI Homes.

articles.title: NBC4 chopper's final moments: A blaring alarm, loss of altitude and panic. Why did it crash?
articles.summary: The crash that killed three people on Tuesday night, including two NBC4 journalists, involved a single-engine AS350 B2 helicopter. Questions surround why it...
articles.body:
NBC4's helicopter was one of several news aircraft flying over the scene of a deadly bus crash in Chatsworth on Tuesday evening at sunset.

It's common for multiple news choppers to arrive at the scene of breaking news, beaming live images for newscasts and streaming.

But around 7 p.m., something went horribly wrong. In a matter of seconds, the NBC4 chopper dropped out of the sky, crashing into shipping containers and vehicles outside a warehouse a few blocks away, bursting into flames. Two station journalists, reporter Eliana Moreno and pilot George Marciniw, were killed along with a bystander on the ground.

Federal investigators are now trying to figure out what went wrong. The Times interviewed several experts, who reviewed recordings of the chopper's final moments. They offered insights into the helicopter itself, its movements that afternoon and what is known about how its mechanics work.

A video stream from the helicopter, as it was covering the bus crash, appears to show the helicopter hovering just before it came crashing down. An alarm can be heard blaring as the helicopter appears to be quickly losing altitude.

That alarm would be triggered by a potential engine failure, causing low propeller rotation, or a problem with the hydraulic system, said Jack Cress, a former helicopter pilot for the U.S. Marine Corps and a helicopter accident investigation instructor at USC's Aviation Safety and Security Program.

If the helicopter suddenly loses revolutions per minute, or RPMs, there is a safety maneuver known as autorotation, in which the pilot can try to gain enough momentum and upward flow on the rotor blades as it descends and moves laterally to increase rotation and control its landing. But Cress said the fact that the helicopter appeared to be hovering in the air, and at a low altitude, would make it difficult for the pilot to execute the maneuver.

Jeff Guzzetti, a former National Transportation Safety Board and Federal Aviation Administration investigator as well as an instructor in USC's Aviation Safety and Security Program, also believes the horn heard in the video was a low rotor RPM alarm, he said, and that the audio seems to indicate a mechanical problem moments before the crash.

"You can hear something mechanical that is winding down in the background," he said. "It does seem like something mechanical suddenly happened to the helicopter while it was in stable flight."

NTSB investigators have also zeroed in on that recording. In it, the sound of the engine's motor winds down and a horn blares, possibly warning the pilot that the main rotor speed had dropped too low or the helicopter had lost hydraulics. Moreno responds to the noise with a quiet, "Uh-oh."

The angle of the camera begins to descend and Moreno is heard asking, "You can't pull up?" before the video cuts out. Moreno, Marciniw and 29-year-old Edy Gutierrez Mejia, who was on the ground when the chopper went down, were killed.

"That video is probably the most important piece of evidence we have recovered so far," said NTSB Investigator Fabian Salazar.

Cress compared the autorotation maneuver to a fixed-wing airplane gliding through air with the force generated by its wings, but the helicopter would use the upward force on its rotors caused by descending, or moving forward, to make the rotors turn fast enough to keep itself in the air.

In this case, Cress said, the pilot may not have had that chance.

"He's in the worst part of the height-velocity curve," Cress said, referring to a chart referenced by helicopter pilots that tracks height and air speed for safe flight conditions. "That is a dangerous place to be."

Helicopter pilots are trained to stay away from those conditions, Cress said, because the lack of altitude and forward momentum give them little recourse if there is engine trouble.

But Cress points out that for news helicopters, and police choppers, hovering and maintaining low altitude is a common practice.

Thomas Anthony, director of USC's Aviation Safety and Security Program, said the AS350 B2 helicopter in Tuesday's crash is not only a popular helicopter to see in the skies, but one that is typically very reliable.

It is the most commonly used helicopter for both law enforcement and news gathering, he said, adding that it's "the workhorse of the helicopter fleet."

The helicopter is known for its reliability, is easily fixed when an issue arises, and has a reputation for "robust maintenance support" from its manufacturer, Anthony said.

But the nature of the work in both news and police helicopters increases their risk, Anthony said. While pilots and instructors stress standardizing procedures and flight paths, news incidents such as police chases, fires and crashes force pilots into new conditions during every flight.

The AS350 B2, Cress said, is a reliable model and popular across the globe with a good safety record. But he added some of the features that make the model reliable may have contributed to the crash.

"In 999 out of 1,000 flights, this is a great helicopter," Cress said.

The single-engine and light design is reliable and maintains a good track record, but Cress said any kind of engine failure can also mean there's no secondary engine to help the pilot bring the helicopter down.

The light design of the rotors also means that if there is an engine failure, the light blades can lose their momentum in rotation quickly, Cress said.

Those conditions of hovering in the air, with little altitude and no momentum are commonly referred to by helicopter pilots as a "dead man's curve," said Guzzetti.

"That's the worst place to be if you have a problem," Guzzetti said.

This story originally appeared in Los Angeles Times .
authors: Salvador Hernandez, Hannah Fry, Richard Winton

articles.title: Former MI6 spy takes Trump to Scottish court for £800,000 legal payout
articles.summary: Christopher Steele was the author of a salacious "dossier" linking Trump to Russia during his 2016 election campaign.
articles.body:
A company founded by a former spy is pursuing Donald Trump at a small Scottish court for more than £800,000 in unpaid legal costs.

The US president was named in a hearing at Ayr Sheriff Court as Orbis Business Intelligence seeks funds from the Trump Turnberry golf resort.

The case concerns legal costs owed by Trump from a 2024 English data protection case against Orbis's director Christopher Steele - a former MI6 agent.

But SLC Turnberry Limited - which owns the course - is disputing Trump's role as the "ultimate owner", arguing that his stake in the course is held by a trust.

Steele was the author of a salacious "dossier" linking Trump to Russia during his 2016 election campaign.

London's High Court of Justice ruled Trump's action out of time and a judge ordered him to pay Orbis £680,000 in legal costs.

Orbis is targeting the president's financial interests at Turnberry in order to claim the funds.

The case called at Ayr Sheriff Court because the resort falls within its jurisdiction, while Steele and Orbis have no connections there.

Sheriff officers served papers at the Trump Turnberry resort last September.

Court documents named Trump as a "debtor" and reveal that, due to interest, the amount sought by two applications brought by Orbis totals £789,812.

In an online procedural hearing Orbis's advocate Duncan Hamilton KC stated that, despite an English court ordering the president to pay money to Orbis, "over the last 18 months since the last judgement, he has refused or failed to do so".

Due to interest accruing, he said, the costs now claimed by his client were now "north of £800,000" and that the applicant had spent "a great deal of time and money chasing president Trump in various jurisdictions."

Hamilton continued: "President Trump has stated emphatically that he owns Turnberry.

"He has committed that to federal filings of assets... He has made that clear in a witness statement to the High Court."

Stating that Turnberry said the president was not the owner, the KC said Trump was "being put in a degree of legal and reputational jeopardy by the position adopted by Turnberry" as it implies his previous assertions were false.

Turnberry's advocate David Massaro told the court that the company was not claiming that president's statements were false.

Massaro said Trump's stake at the course "ultimately rests in a trust in the US, and as they have averred, the president is the beneficiary".

He stated that it was his client's position that shares are held by trustees and that this is not a "sufficient link" to the company.

Sheriff Millar ordered a further hearing to take place in November and that the president be informed of the updated amount claimed by Orbis.

Steele is a director of Orbis and a former head of MI6's Russia desk.

In 2016, he was hired by a law firm linked to the Hillary Clinton presidential campaign to gather information on then-Republican nominee Trump's alleged links to Russia.

The so-called Steele dossier included a series of uncorroborated intelligence claims , including that the US president had been cultivated by Russia, that he had taken part in sex parties and had been "compromised" by the Russian security services.

The dossier was later published without permission by the website Buzzfeed in 2017.

Trump denies all the claims and launched legal action against Orbis through English courts.

In February 2024 the case brought by Trump against Orbis was thrown out.

Last April, a court ordered the president to pay Orbis more than £600,000 in legal costs.

Ayr Sheriff Court documents reveal that, due to interest, the amount sought by two applications brought by Orbis now totals £789,812.91.

The Trump family acquired the Turnberry resort in Ayrshire in June 2014.

Donald Trump was a director at the company SLC Turnberry Ltd until he resigned the position in January 2017 - a day before he was inaugurated as US president.

His sons, Don Jr and Eric, remain directors at the company.

Information held by Companies House states that Donald Trump Snr has significant control of a company called Golf Recreation Scotland, which in turn has significant control at SLC Turnberry.

A person with significant control is usually someone who has more than 25% shares or voting rights in a company, can appoint or remove a majority of directors, or can influence or control the company.

In September last year, the Daily Mail reported that sheriff officers had served legal papers at the Trump Turnberry resort.

At the time, a spokesperson for Orbis told the newspaper it was "concerned that Donald Trump continues to be in breach of the English High Court and are alarmed by the outrageous costs of this vexatious case in wasted time and money".

In court documents, Donald Trump is named as a "debtor" while it lists SLC Turnberry Limited - the company that runs the resort - is named as an "arrestee".
authors: Chris Clements - Scotland social affairs correspondent

articles.title: Kanimozhi meets Mamata Banerjee as DMK works on third front
articles.summary: CHENNAI: DMK has started working on the formation of a prospective third front by trying to wean away some of the INDIA bloc constituents.DMK deputy g.
articles.body: CHENNAI: DMK has started working on the formation of a prospective third front by trying to wean away some of the INDIA bloc constituents.DMK deputy general secretary and MP Kanimozhi Rajathi Karunanidhi met Trinamool Congress chief and former West Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee at her Kalighat residence in Kolkata on Thursday. This came after Kanimozhi’s meetings with Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Uddhav Thackerey and NCP (SP) MP Supriya Sule in Mumbai on Sept 12.DMK broke all ties with Congress since the latter walked out of its alliance to join the TVK-led govt in Tamil Nadu in May. A DMK leader said Kanimozhi has been tasked with reaching out to opposition leaders.“We are exploring the possibility of a third front without Congress,” the leader said.Kanimozhi’s discussions with these leaders have predominantly been on the proposed delimitation, though the broader idea is to bring them on board. Mamata has been particularly unhappy with Congress after the latter rejected her seat-sharing offer for the Oct 6 Nandigram and Rejinagar byelections.A senior Trinamool MP said, “Mamata Banerjee shares an excellent relationship with DMK chief M K Stalin. She also maintains very good ties with non-NDA parties and remains close to INDIA bloc members that are not allied with Congress. Today’s discussion was strictly between her and Kanimozhi. Anything said beyond that would be speculation.”NCP (SP) sources said the party leadership remains non-committal to DMK’s proposal. “DMK floated the idea of a third front, and a preliminary meeting was held. DMK is testing the waters with opposition parties with which it has a good equation, unlike Congress,” a senior NCP leader said.Meanwhile, chief minister C Joseph Vijay on Sept 9 named the TVK-led combine as Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance (SSJVA), which includes erstwhile DMK allies Congress, VCK and IUML. articles.title: In 2023, a Kentucky farmer found an 1856 silver half dollar in his field; within an hour, he uncovered 800+ coins, including 18 rare 1863 Double Eagles, later sold for more than $3 million
articles.summary: US News: A Kentucky farmer working in his field has uncovered an extraordinary collection of Civil War-era coins. He found more than 800 gold and silver coins,.
articles.body: A Kentucky farmer working in his field has uncovered an extraordinary collection of Civil War-era coins. He found more than 800 gold and silver coins, which later sold for more than $3 million (£2.36 million) through private sales. The discovery, now known to coin experts as the "Great Kentucky Hoard", began when the farmer found a single 1856 Seated Liberty silver half dollar in the dirt. "I initially found the 1856 Seated Liberty Half Dollar probably 20 to 30 feet from where the hoard was located," the farmer later said in an interview with the public television programme Kentucky Life. "I would have never believed what came next. Things that only happen in dreams." As he continued walking across his property, he noticed something shiny in the soil. "When I continued walking and saw the glint of gold, a thick reeded edge," he told the broadcaster. "When I pulled the coin from the ground, I was astonished when I realized I was holding a $20 Double Eagle from the 1860s. After I flipped the first clump of dirt over the next 45 minutes to an hour, the coins kept coming. I knew it was hundreds." Within about an hour of digging, he had recovered more than 700 gold coins and several dozen silver pieces. The discovery revealed a collection that had been buried for more than 160 years.Rarest American gold pieces found intactAfter finding the coins, the farmer sought professional help to identify and protect them. He also took steps to keep his name and the exact location of his farm private to prevent people from trespassing on the property. The collection was sent to the Numismatic Guaranty Company (NGC) for authentication, cleaning and grading. According to information published by NGC, most of the discovery consisted of $1 US gold dollars made between 1850 and 1862. The hoard also contained smaller numbers of $10 Liberty gold coins and $20 Liberty Double Eagles. One of the most important parts of the discovery was a group of 18 1863-P $20 Gold Liberty Double Eagles. Collectors highly value this particular type because the US Treasury produced only 3,607 of the coins for circulation during the Civil War year. Finding even one 1863 Double Eagle in uncirculated condition is considered a major event for coin collectors. Finding 18 well-preserved examples in one place was extremely unusual. Jeff Garrett, a coin expert with Mid-America Rare Coin Galleries who examined the collection, described the discovery as an important moment in his career during his appearance on Kentucky Life. "The importance of this discovery cannot be overstated," Garrett said in NGC's official report on the hoard. "Finding one Mint condition 1863 Double Eagle would be an important numismatic event. Finding nearly a roll of superb examples is hard to comprehend." Individual 1863 $20 Double Eagles from the hoard were later valued at more than $100,000 each because of their excellent condition.Civil War conflict may explain buried coinsHistorical information from the Smithsonian Institution suggests that the coins were buried around 1863, during one of the most dangerous periods of the American Civil War. Kentucky officially declared itself neutral when the war began in 1861, but the state soon became an important battleground between Union and Confederate supporters. In the summer of 1863, Confederate General John Hunt Morgan led a series of cavalry raids, known as Morgan's Raid, through Kentucky, Ohio and Indiana. Historians from the Smithsonian Institution say wealthy landowners and farmers often buried paper money, silver and gold coins in fields to protect their savings from soldiers and armed groups. Some people who buried their wealth were later killed, forced to leave their homes or captured during the war. As a result, many buried collections remained underground for generations. The coin dealer GovMint later handled the commercial sale of the certified coins. Individual pieces were offered to private collectors with special labels identifying them as genuine coins from the Great Kentucky Hoard. Private buyers and investors eventually purchased the collection, generating more than $3 million (£2.36 million) for the anonymous finder.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: Rhode Island pilot recycled 80 short tons of fibreglass from old boats using a $105,000 NOAA grant, turning shredded hulls into cement material
articles.summary: US News: A Rhode Island pilot is demonstrating how fibreglass boat recycling could provide an alternative to sending old and derelict vessels to landfill. The .
articles.body: A Rhode Island pilot is demonstrating how fibreglass boat recycling could provide an alternative to sending old and derelict vessels to landfill. The programme shredded fibreglass hulls and sent the material to a cement manufacturer for use in cement production. According to a Rhode Island Marine Trade Association Foundation report, the pilot recycled 80 short tons of fibreglass from derelict and abandoned boats. NOAA later reported that RIMTA recycled nearly 20 metric tonnes of fibreglass in New England during the project period. Backed by a $105,000 NOAA grant, the initiative explored how the model could expand beyond Rhode Island as about 200,000 recreational boats reach the end of their usable life in the US each year.How RIMTA tested a new way to reuse old boat hullsThe Rhode Island initiative, led by RIMTA executive director Brian Dursi as a “proof of concept” programme. The programme recycled 80 short tons of fibreglass material from derelict or abandoned boats and incorporated it into cement. That is about 72.6 metric tonnes, although the original report gives the figure in short tons.According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, the project was part of a broader effort to establish a sustainable model for end-of-life vessel recycling. The programme helped expand interest in vessel recycling beyond Rhode Island, with states including Ohio, Maryland, Virginia, California, Washington, North Carolina, South Carolina, Connecticut, Massachusetts and Maine engaging in the process. RIMTA successfully recycled nearly 20 metric tons of fibreglass in New England during the project period.Shredded fibreglass was used in cement productionThe key part of the Rhode Island model was not conventional recycling into another fibreglass product. Instead, the shredded material was sent to a cement manufacturer, where it could be used during cement production. When fibreglass from end-of-life boats is co-processed in a cement kiln, it can provide both thermal energy and a replacement for some raw materials used to make cement.This approach gave the unwanted boat material a use while addressing a disposal problem that has few established alternatives. The project also demonstrated how a network involving boat owners, marinas, dismantlers, transporters, shredders and cement producers could be assembled. However, the process remained expensive, with costs associated with dismantling boats, shredding fibreglass, transporting the material and getting cement kilns to accept it.The $105,000 grant aimed to expand boat recyclingThe programme received a $105,000 NOAA grant to explore whether Rhode Island’s approach could support a national vessel-recycling model. Several states, including Maryland, Virginia, California, Washington and Massachusetts, became involved in exploring or establishing vessel-recycling programmes.The scale of the problem is significant, with NOAA estimating that about 200,000 recreational boats reach the end of their usable life in the US each year. However, Rhode Island’s programme was paused after its grant funding ran out, as RIMTA searched for new partnerships and funding to make fibreglass recycling more financially sustainable.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: US F-16 fighter jet crashes in Michigan, bursts into flames
articles.summary: US News: An F-16 fighter jet from Texas crashed in rural Michigan on Thursday during a routine training exercise, with the pilot ejecting safely before being t.
articles.body: An F-16 fighter jet from Texas crashed in rural Michigan on Thursday during a routine training exercise, with the pilot ejecting safely before being taken to a local hospital, a military spokesman said.The aircraft was taking part in exercises at a National Guard base in Alpena, about 190 miles (305 km) north of Detroit, when it went down. Sgt. Derek Gutierrez, a public affairs specialist with the 149th Fighter Wing, said the pilot was receiving medical treatment but declined to provide the pilot’s name or details about any injuries, citing military policy.The crash sent a plume of dark smoke into the air and prompted reports of explosions from people living nearby.The fighter jet was among several F-16s from Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland in Texas participating in the Michigan exercises, Gutierrez said.Wendy Sobeck, who lives in the area with her husband, said they initially believed a vehicle had crashed near their home. “We thought there was a car accident outside our house. We saw big billowing black smoke. We couldn’t tell what it was, so my husband got into his pickup truck and saw what happened,” she said. “You could see the plane debris in the field. Explosions kept happening," she said, as quoted by AP.Her husband, Fred Sobeck, 65, said he saw flames after driving toward the crash site. “Police told me to get out of there because of explosions,” he said, recalling a “big fireball in the field” near a house and a camper. Neither structure was hit, he said.The US military began operating F-16s in 1979. The Air Force Safety Center records at least 14 Class A mishaps involving the aircraft since 2000. The designation generally applies when an incident results in more than $2 million in damage, destroys an aircraft or causes a service member’s death.Another F-16C Fighting Falcon crashed in California’s desert in December while flying with the US Air Force Thunderbirds. articles.title: Andy Burnham: UK Prime Minister to meet Irish Taoiseach Micheal Martin
articles.summary: Martin will be the first international leader to visit Number 10 North, the government said ahead of the talks.
articles.body:
The Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Taoiseach (Irish PM) Micheál Martin will hold their first official meeting in Manchester on Friday.

Martin will be the first international leader to visit Number 10 North, the government said ahead of the talks.

The men are expected to discuss further strengthening of the UK/Ireland relationship including boosting trade, security and working with the EU.

Burnham said he was "delighted" to be hosting the taoiseach and said it was an "historic and proud day for Manchester".

"No10 North is all about creating opportunities for working people, and our partnership with Ireland as we improve the lives of people in both of our countries is a key part of that," he said.

"There is so much we can achieve together: from our shared commitment to the Good Friday Agreement, to trade, to working with Europe and supporting Ukraine. We are the closest of friends, and I look forward to further strengthening that friendship."

Following their meeting, the leaders will visit a local Irish community centre to meet with representatives from the Irish community in Greater Manchester.

The visit comes days after US President Donald Trump made remarks supporting a "unified Ireland" .

On his visit to Northern Ireland last month, Burnham said a border poll was "off the table" , but later said he stood by the Good Friday Agreement.

It is also expected that the two leaders will discuss reform of the Stormont institutions as well as progress on replacing the controversial Troubles legacy act during their meeting.

In a statement, Martin said they will discuss the "UK-Ireland 2030 programme of strategic cooperation" as well as "a range of matters relating to Northern Ireland".

The statement said these matters include legacy and the Good Friday Agreement.

He added: "Our discussions will also cover EU and international issues, including Ireland's current Presidency of the Council of the EU and the next EU-UK Summit, and the situation in Ukraine, Gaza and the Middle East more broadly.''

Last week, the taoiseach said there should be "greater clarity" about what would lead to a border poll being called.

Martin said that in his view it's "not satisfactory" that the decision to call a referendum is left simply as a "judgement call" for the Northern Ireland secretary.

During his first visit to Northern Ireland last month, Burnham said a border poll was "off the table" and that votes on Brexit and Scottish independence showed the "risks that come from those situations take a long time to heal".

Northern Ireland Secretary Sir Chris Bryant later said he and the prime minister "stand full square" behind all of the 1998 Good Friday Agreement, including its provisions for a border poll.

"I welcome his [Burnham's] comments in terms of accepting... and he clarified very clear that he accepts the principle of consent, he said that within the Good Friday Agreement a referendum is allowed for," Martin told BBC Radio Ulster's Borderland podcast last week.

"Obviously the circumstances around that, as to the triggering of that was deliberately left somewhat ambiguous at the time.

"I think there needs to be discussion on that, no question, as part of a wider discussion between all of us, because we are all co-guarantors of the agreement and in addition to that I welcome what he said on legacy as he did commit to legacy and I agree with him on the need for reform of the institutions."

What does Good Friday Agreement say on border poll?

The Good Friday Agreement, also known as the Belfast Agreement, was a political deal designed to bring an end to 30 years of violent conflict in Northern Ireland, known as the Troubles.

It was signed on 10 April 1998 and approved by public votes in Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland.

It set up a new government for Northern Ireland, representing both nationalists and unionists.

The agreement says that Northern Ireland is part of the UK and this can change only through a referendum.

The secretary of state must hold a border poll if it appears likely that a majority of people in Northern Ireland would vote for Irish unification.

There is no detail in the agreement on how the secretary of state should judge whether there is majority support - but they can decide to hold a border poll at any time, provided that there has not been another in the last seven years.

There is also debate as to what form a border poll should take, for example whether the poll should be held on the general principle of unification or after specific proposals have been set out for how a united Ireland would be governed.

articles.title: Rapist police officer was first arrested and released 17 years ago
articles.summary: Police officer Campbell Petrie was convicted of raping two women at the High Court in Glasgow.
articles.body:
A former police sergeant convicted of rape was first arrested 17 years ago following a complaint from one of his victims.

Campbell Petrie, 50, is facing a lengthy jail sentence after being found guilty of sex offences and violence against two women between 2006 and 2022.

Police Scotland told BBC News that one of the women, who he met through his job, made a complaint of threatening behaviour against Petrie in 2009.

He was arrested and held in a police station for five hours, but no further action was taken because of a lack of evidence.

Petrie remained a serving officer until another woman made an allegation of rape against him in October 2023, prompting an investigation by specialist sexual crime officers.

He was arrested, charged and suspended in December 2023, and retired from the force two years later.

Petrie denied the allegations but was convicted of nine charges after a trial at the High Court in Glasgow.

Police officer guilty of series of rapes and sex attacks over 17 years

The case has appalled workers at Rape Crisis Scotland, which supports survivors of sexual violence.

The organisation's external affairs manager, Nicola Love, said: "It does stick in the throat that someone like that is allowed to leave the force on their own terms, instead of as a result of what they've done.

"We know perpetrators come from all walks of life, and that does include the police force, but it provokes an intense reaction because these people have a duty to protect us.

"There's an expectation that they keep us safe, and this flies in the face of that."

Petrie was found guilty of indecently assaulting one of the women while she was asleep and on various occasions between 2006 and 2009.

He was convicted of raping the second woman on multiple occasions between 2011 and 2014.

A trial found he assaulted both women to the danger of their lives by grabbing their throats and restricting their breathing.

Petrie's conviction means that three serving or former Police Scotland officers have been exposed as rapists this year.

In July, Cameron Ross was jailed for ten years for raping two women and subjecting a third to a campaign of abuse.

Three weeks later, a BBC Disclosure investigation revealed that Alan Greer - a police officer who took his own life in May - was a violent rapist who had attacked and attempted to murder women over at least 14 years.

Further BBC Scotland inquiries established that Greer had passed vetting checks to join Strathclyde Police in 2009, despite having two reports of criminal behaviour against women on his record.

At least 15 potential victims of Greer have been identified so far and the National Police Chiefs Council (NPCC) has been brought in to carry out an independent investigation.

Under its terms of reference, published this week, the NPCC will try to identify whether his crimes could have been discovered any earlier.

The Petrie case has raised fresh questions over background checks on police in Scotland.

In 2023, all UK forces carried out a "historic data wash" following the crimes of Met officers Wayne Couzens, who abducted and murdered Sarah Everard, and serial rapist David Carrick.

Officers and staff were checked against the national police data base to identify whether they had a criminal past which had been missed.

Police Scotland's deputy chief constable Bex Smith told BBC Scotland: "In 2009 Campbell Petrie was arrested and questioned in connection with a complaint of threatening behaviour, however, the case did not proceed due to insufficient evidence.

"The independent historic data wash, carried out by UK policing between March and July 2023, interrogated the Police National Database and did not identify any unknown information on Petrie.

"The checks carried out by Police Scotland went further than UK forces and included robust interrogation of both the vulnerable person's database and intelligence system."

In total, 23,822 Police Scotland officers, staff and volunteers were checked during that process.

Concerns were raised about just eight individuals, with a civilian member of staff facing a criminal investigation.

In the wake of Petrie's conviction and the Greer case, the Inspectorate of Constabulary in Scotland (HMICS) said they were "deeply concerned" about vetting at the force.

The chief inspector of constabulary, Craig Naylor, said: "HMICS have previously scrutinised Police Scotland's arrangements for vetting, misconduct and the management of officers subject to allegations of wrongdoing, and have made a number of recommendations for improvement.

"We have recently raised concern with both Police Scotland and the Scottish Police Authority about a lack of progress in relation to the vetting of officers within Police Scotland, including the effectiveness of a historic data wash exercise and the associated assurance around these issues."

Strengthening vetting procedures is a key aim of the Police (Ethics, Conduct and Scrutiny) (Scotland) Act passed by the Scottish Parliament in January 2025.

The intention is that all officers will now undergo a career-long, structured regime of on-going vetting.

Scotland's justice secretary Neil Gray described Petrie's case as "extremely disturbing" and his abuse of his position of trust as "abhorrent."

He said: "Police officers are rightly expected to uphold the highest standards of integrity, which is why we have strengthened vetting through legislation and Police Scotland have been clear there is an ongoing programme of work to re-vet all officers."

The new law contains a provision which would allow Police Scotland to continue misconduct proceedings against officers who resign or retire but that part of the legislation has not yet been enacted.

BBC Scotland understands Petrie's conviction is likely to have an impact on his pension. The Scottish Police Authority can seek the forfeiture of his employer's contributions.

Police Scotland said they regarded violence against women and girls, which has become the subject of major public concern and a renewed political focus, as an "absolute priority".

Deputy chief constable Smith praised Petrie's second victim for coming forward in 2023 and noted that her evidence helped the force identify his previous offending.

She said: "We understand how difficult it can be to report these kinds of offences, particularly when the perpetrator is a police officer.

"I want to reassure the public we will identify and investigate these officers whether they are serving or retired, or whether their crimes are committed on duty or, as in this instance, off duty."

That was echoed by the Scottish Police Federation, which represents officers up to the rank of chief inspector.

The federation's chair David Threadgold said: "I will never try to hide from the fact that these are shocking cases and the public are quite rightly asking if they can have confidence in the police.

"But the very fact that these individuals have been identified, investigated and taken through the judicial process, should provide reassurance."

articles.summary: India News: NEW DELHI: The AI boom is creating demand for new and reliable chip manufacturing hubs, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Thursday, pitching India as .
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The AI boom is creating demand for new and reliable chip manufacturing hubs, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said Thursday, pitching India as a destination building the ecosystem that the global semiconductor industry needs.Inaugurating Semicon India 2026, the PM said AI was changing semiconductor requirements beyond smaller transistors, thereby propelling the importance of chip integration, data movement, heat management and dependable power.PM Narendra Modi said, “Today if you are working on AI, the challenges are not only about what is inside the chip, but also about what is happening around it.”These included bringing memory closer to processors and connecting multiple chips to function as one system. Modi said AI demand had contributed significantly to the growth of more than 20% in the global semiconductor market over the past two years.“Amid these challenges, what the world now needs most are new and reliable manufacturing locations,” he said, adding that India was preparing itself to meet that need. India had begun the $13.5-billion second phase of its Semiconductor Mission, following up on the $8-billion first phase, Modi said. Twelve projects had been approved, with the next phase expected to widen participation.He invited equipment manufacturers and suppliers of chemicals, gases and materials to invest, saying India wanted to strengthen domestic supply chains alongside chipmaking. “We want the entire ecosystem to grow together,” he said.He also invited Indian youth conducting research overseas to return to the country to contribute to advanced technology development domestically and urged industry to lead R&D initiatives. The PM identified compound semiconductors and silicon photonics as priorities for AI infrastructure.Govt had introduced reforms allowing international companies to collaborate with Indian startups, design companies and OCIowned companies, he said, while seeking to encourage fabless businesses and domestic intellectual property creation.PM Modi said India’s chip industry progressed from policy discussions-project announcements to commercial production stages. Indian plants were supplying customers at home and abroad, while production was beginning at two more plants in Mohali and Surat.“It takes decades to build technological capabilities. Wherever semiconductor ecosystems have been built in the world, they have been prepared after decades of effort. But India, with your cooperation, has worked simultaneously on chip design and production, equipment manufacturing, materials ecosystem, testing capability — and has shown success,” he said.“India’s success in this critical industry would strengthen global supply chains,” Modi said arguing that its significance bettered even as supply chains are being weaponised.Get the latest India News and Live updates.
